# bookings
FCT-011 [requirement|bookings] Patients can book, move and cancel a visit from the app (from evt_011) | conf 0.90 | stated | quote: "patients can book, move or cancel a visit from the app"
FCT-014 [rule|cancellation] A visit can be cancelled free up to 2 hours before the start (from Q-014) | conf 0.90 | stated | quote: "cancel for free until 2 hours before"

# doctors
FCT-012 [requirement|doctors] Each doctor sets their own weekly hours and leave days (from evt_012) | conf 0.90 | stated | quote: "doctors set their own weekly hours and leave"
FCT-013 [role|doctors] Doctors see their day's list of patients on a phone (from evt_013) | conf 0.85 | stated | quote: "doctors check the day's patient list on the phone"

# reports
FCT-015 [requirement|reports] The owner wants a weekly report of visits and no-shows (from evt_015) | conf 0.85 | stated | quote: "send me a weekly report of visits and no-shows"
FCT-016 [context|chat] Okay, that is all for reports (from evt_016) | conf 0.50 | stated | quote: "ok, that is all for reports"
project: idea.summary: A booking app for a family clinic in Indore
